Subject: POC outcomes and permission to use a short quote & logo

Hi Ariel —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month. I put together a very short summary of the outcomes for Terranet; attaching the two-pager with the key metrics (terranet_poc_kpis.pdf) and a one-page consent template for using a short quote/logo (consent_template.docx). TL;DR results we saw in the pilot:

- Average inference latency reduced from ~210ms to ~95ms (55% improvement) under typical batch mixes.
- Mean cost per 1k tokens dropped ~38% after applying prefix caching and a quantization profile.
- 99th percentile latency improved from 520ms to 220ms (stable under production load).
- Token throughput increased ~1.8x for your peak window (media ingestion workflow).

These numbers are in the PDF but I wanted to call them out because marketing would love a 1–2 line quote and permission to use Terranet’s name + logo in a short case highlight. Would you be comfortable with either:

1) A one-line quote we can publish as-is (we can draft it and you can edit), and a quick 10–15 minute call to record / confirm it?
2) Or, if you prefer, a written sign-off on the attached consent template that our legal/marketing teams can publish under your terms?

If you're open to a quick call, Marcus (CS) will run the short recording and Soojin (marketing) will assemble the one-liner. Options we have next week: Tue 3/23 10–11am PT or Thu 3/25 2–4pm PT. If neither works, tell me times that do and we’ll adapt.

Thanks again — the team is thrilled with the results you shipped in production.

Best,

Kimberly Park
